sn22.94:1.5: The Buddha rejects the metaphysical views of absolute, eternal existence and annihilation ([sn12.15:3.1](), [sn12.48:2.2]()), but he asserts the reality of that which is conditioned and impermanent, namely the aggregates.
sn22.94:4.1: “Worldly phenomenon” (_lokadhamma_) plays on the dual meanings of “worldly” and “temporary”.
